description: A studio music supervisor must finalize the music package for an international documentary teaser, including the track, excerpt length, territories, mix, exact credit, and clearance records before the teaser is delivered to platforms.

shared_context.S1: The studio is preparing a 60-second international teaser for the documentary feature 'Tidal Memory.'
shared_context.S2: Mara has final authority over the teaser's music package and its delivery records.
shared_context.S3: The draft edit is built around either 'Midnight Arcade' by Vela North or 'Paper Satellites' by Rowan Hale.
shared_context.S4: The draft package lists worldwide use, a full-mix excerpt, and a provisional music credit.
shared_context.S5: The studio's normal final-clearance meeting reviews rights, composer approvals, and platform delivery requirements before Mara locks the package.

PF1.text: Jonas reviewed the executed music licenses this morning and confirmed that 'Paper Satellites' is cleared for use in exactly the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia, while 'Midnight Arcade' is not cleared for the teaser's planned international territories; he has not yet entered the territory matrix in the delivery file.

PF2.text: Leila confirmed with Rowan Hale's publisher today that 'Paper Satellites' may be used in the teaser only as its instrumental mix and that the on-screen credit must read exactly 'Paper Satellites — written by Rowan Hale'; the publisher's email is still filed in Leila's correspondence folder rather than the clearance packet.

PF3.text: Owen confirmed with the three launch platforms during today's delivery check that each platform permits a music excerpt of no more than exactly 12 seconds, beginning at 00:18 in the teaser; this specification has not yet been added to the marketing export sheet.

acceptance_conditions: The excerpt must be exactly 12 seconds and begin at 00:18.
The territory field must list exactly the four cleared territories.
The teaser must use the instrumental mix.
The on-screen credit must use the exact publisher-approved wording.
A territory-matrix update, composer-approval record, and platform-export update must be committed.
The rights finding must be spoken by Jonas and cited by Mara.

content_checks.C4: decisions['territories'] == 'United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia'
content_checks.C6: decisions['on_screen_credit'] == 'Paper Satellites — written by Rowan Hale'

decisive_facts.why: The license review changes the usable track to 'Paper Satellites', restricts the territory field to exactly four countries, and creates the required territory-matrix update.
The publisher approval changes the mix from the draft full mix to instrumental, fixes the credit to 'Paper Satellites — written by Rowan Hale', and requires a composer-approval record.
The platform check changes the excerpt to exactly 12 seconds beginning at 00:18 and requires the platform-export update.
